text: When fully paid beforehand, you are more than a common mortal if you can feel the same interest in the case as if something was still in prospect for you, as well as for your client. And when you lack interest in the case the job will very likely lack skill and diligence in the performance.
author: Abraham Lincoln
reference: Speeches and Letters of Abraham Lincoln, 1832-1865
locator: Note for Law Lecture. Written about July 1, 1850
